integrity: The finite witness is reconstructed from the published definitions. The bundled verifier checks closure minimality, every distinct factor and occurrence needed for the upper bound, a transparent seven-factor lower-bound certificate, and all 58,905 four-position sets. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is one explicit finite counterexample. It does not determine a replacement universal bound or whether generalized pseudostandard prefixes have bounded attractor number. An unindexed prior observation remains a residual originality risk.
title: A length-\(36\) counterexample to the four-attractor conjecture for binary generalized pseudostandard words
